يقتطفوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَطِفُوا (yaqtaṭifū) /jaq.ta.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# يُقْتَطَفُوا (yuqtaṭafū) /juq.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
